}}'''Nerith''' is a ''[[sul'dam]]'' in the [[Seanchan]] army.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nerith}} Her ''[[damane]]'' was [[Gille]].

== Appearance ==
She has a square face.

== Activities ==
While traveling to [[Illian]], her outpost is attacked by [[Rand al'Thor]]'s army and she is captured. When she is told she will be prisoner to [[Aes Sedai]] in [[Caemlyn]] she panics and tries to escape.

Although she is tied, she still manages to bite a [[Saldaean]] in the wrist.
